statement: The pinned SDL Bluetooth fallback decoder distinguishes a 16-byte older Xbox One S state report from longer states, and documents varying Guide, Back, paddle and Share positions for older controller firmware and Xbox Series firmware 5.5.2641. Its Series example uses a 17-byte state report, with the Share bit in its final byte; this fallback does not establish an invariant native descriptor for all current Series firmware.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox Series controller, model 1914, with explicitly labelled older/Elite comparators
applicability.firmware: SDL source documents Series 5.5.2641; other firmware variants are comparator examples
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_xboxone.c:1257-1311 and 1377-1450; firmware examples in source are host decoder expectations, not real-device revalidation.
